description: Database view exposing salesman of the month data.
business_purpose: Used to track and report salesman of the month records, including amounts and quantities, for the Sales Planning & Performance area.
record_granularity: One row represents one record returned by the salesman of the month view.

columns.name: userid
columns.description: Userid of the salesman of the month.

columns.name: branch_id
columns.description: Branch id of the salesman of the month.

columns.name: total_sheets
columns.description: Total sheets of the salesman of the month.

business_rules: Use total_sheets for monetary or quantity totals.
Vw_SalesmanOfTheMonth is a database view: it is read-only and its rows are computed, so apply filters and a LIMIT when querying.
common_queries: Count of salesman of the month

known_issues: total_sheets is nullable; use COALESCE when summing or comparing.
Views expose no primary key or nullability guarantees; rows may repeat depending on the view definition.

query_notes: The database is MySQL/MariaDB; use MySQL syntax and the exact name Vw_SalesmanOfTheMonth (identifiers can be case-sensitive).
Use SUM(total_sheets) for totals of total sheets.
This is a view; always apply filters and a LIMIT, as it may be expensive to scan.
